contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): 1,450.00' on p123, equal to the cover's Cumulative Totals cell (1450.00)
contributions.detail: 3 Form A rows (1,000.00 + 300.00 + 150.00) sum to 1,450.00 exactly = the schedule's printed total = the cover's CUMULATIVE column. This is the scope case the rubric calls 'exact', and it is the opposite of the period-scoped filings elsewhere in this chunk: this is a December-5 FINAL report on which the filer wrote 0 in the whole This-Report column (nothing happened between the October report and the final), so the only cover figure the schedule can match is the cumulative one - and it matches to the cent, over a schedule that restates the entire cycle back to 1/2/2024. Anchoring on This Report (0) would be the wrong-scope figure. Nothing was synthesized by differencing covers. 2024 3-line variant, no separate <=$50 aggregate line. No in-kind rows, so both in-kind conventions agree.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report): 907.19' on p124, equal to the cover's Cumulative Totals cell (907.19)
expenditures.detail: 6 Form B rows (747.61 + 18.69 + 1.48 + 22.94 + 100.00 + 16.47) sum to 907.19 exactly = the schedule's printed total = the cover's Cumulative column, with 0 written in This Report for the same reason. The schedule restates the whole cycle 1/5/2024-10/2/2024.

escalation_note: Four 700 dpi tight --value crops, two per schedule page, all A3 indexing proofs: p123 row 1 rendered '1,000.00' and row 3 rendered '150.00'; p124 row 1 rendered '747.61' and row 6 rendered '16.47'. No legibility escalation was needed: the cover is handwritten but both schedules are typed, and both sides closed exactly on the first full-page read. (These three pages are ordinary 612x792 pt letter pages - unlike pp.161-164 of this same archive, whose 2550x3300 pt mediabox defeats a 900 dpi crop.)

123.measure_note: ROTATED LANDSCAPE SHEET rendered portrait: the printed text reads bottom-to-top and the table's ROWS advance LEFT-TO-RIGHT, so axis='x'. COLUMN bands are therefore the horizontal rules and ROW bands the vertical ones - and rowbands detected NO v_rules here, so all three row bands are HAND-MEASURED off the 200 dpi full-page render and crop-proven. The h_rules on this page are ALSO largely unusable: 61 were detected, but most are the rotated TEXT's own dark runs (the amount digits alone throw ten rules between 4 and 10 pct), so only the two that bound the Amount column - the table edge at ~3.9 and the first column rule at 14.75 - were used, and cells claims only that one measured column rather than dressing the noise up as a grid. The header labels and the form's grey hatched spacer strip both sit left of 15.2 pct and are excluded. PROOF (A3): pct:15.2,3.9,2.8,10.85@p123 rendered '1,000.00' (row 1) and pct:20.8,3.9,3.0,10.85@p123 rendered '150.00' (row 3) - the recorded first and last amounts, in order.

124.measure_note: Same rotated-landscape geometry, axis='x'. The Amount column band [1.64,12.34] is taken from the two clean h_rules that bound it (the rest of that page's 24 detected rules are text noise from the rotated Purpose/City columns). No v_rules, so the 6 row bands are hand-measured: row 1 starts at 19.7 pct and the printed pitch is a constant 3.06 pct, which the two proof crops confirm at BOTH ends of the run rather than at one end only. The grey hatched spacer strip left of 19.7 is excluded, as are the blank printed rows after row 6. PROOF (A3): pct:19.7,1.64,3.1,10.7@p124 rendered '747.61' (row 1) and pct:35.0,1.64,3.1,10.7@p124 rendered '16.47' (row 6).

notes: HANDWRITTEN cover (signed 12/3/24, December-5 final report) over TYPED schedules; p122 cover, p123 Form A, p124 Form B, both schedules bound as rotated landscape sheets. The filer wrote a bare '0' in every This-Report cell and the cover's three columns close (1450.00 + 0 = 1450.00; 907.19 + 0 = 907.19; 542.81 + 0 = 542.81), so both schedules are CUMULATIVE-scoped restatements of the whole cycle - the only two 'exact' (rather than period-exact) sides among the 2024 filings in this chunk. PRIVACY: the county blacked out the candidate's whole address block on the cover, but Form A prints donor street addresses in the clear - they are NOT carried (city/state only), and the county's redaction is again shown to be applied to the cover but not to the schedules. The candidate self-funded 1,300 of the 1,450 raised. Two filer misspellings are kept verbatim ('Canidate Filing Fee', 'Candy for Canidate Meet'), as is the payee 'Weber County Republican GOP Website' for what the purpose column calls a convention table fee. The cover's December-5 checkbox carries the county's own stale year ('through December 31, 2022' on a 2024 form) - a form-template defect seen on every 2024 cover in this chunk.
